snippet.title: Matchmaking for Ghosts | DEMO Trailer
snippet.description:
Matchmaking for Ghosts (MFG) is a narrative-driven visual novel game where you play as one of the dead, thrown into an afterlife hotel by Death itself.

Here, you are given one final chance: to connect, to love, and to be understood.

Form bonds with other lost souls through fun conversations, risky flirting, and difficult decisions. At the end, your efforts will be judged: ascension, descent, or something worse, awaits. 

PLAY HERE:
https://phenomcloud.itch.io/matchmaking-for-ghosts
